observations: body: the line numbers 5 to 40 stand in the left margin and the locator «p. 135.» (L20) in the right margin. The signature 12 stands at the foot of the page, at the right.

body: many words, above all at the beginnings of the lines and in the last line of the note column at the left, are printed with heavier ink than their neighbours; they are in the roman type of the text.
body L26: the foot of the i of «eius» is printed bent to the left, a little under the line; the letter is an i, not a j.
body L2: the stem of the d of «adhibenda» is printed bent over at the top; it is not an accent.
body L15: a short speck stands at mid height before «digiti»; it is not a sign.
body L32: the letter of the reference (e) is bold italic.
body L38-L42: the letters of the figure (E, AC, BD, ABCD, H, K, HK, L, KL) are set in the roman capitals of the text.
notes_right L3: the t of «Plato» is printed broken, as two points.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
